newsitem.title: USA: Praxair, Trailigaz form global alliance.
newsitem.headline: Praxair, Trailigaz form global alliance.

text.p: Praxair Inc and Trailigaz, a supplier of ozone systems, said they have formed a worldwide alliance, Praxair-Trailigaz Ozone.

Praxair-Trailigaz Ozone will combine Praxair's knowledge in development, engineering and manufacturing systems integral to producing ozone as a disinfectant and bleaching agent with Trailigaz's ozone production systems.
Trailigaz is a unit of France's Cie Generale des Eaux.

As part of the alliance, Praxair purchased Henkel Corp's interest in Emery-Trailigaz Ozone Co to form the alliance, which is a leading North American designer and supplier of ozone generators, feed gas systems, and related technologies.

The partners estimate that the alliance will generate approximately $40 million in new revenues by the year 2000 due to the growth opportunities, particularly in the water treatment and pulp bleaching industries, the companies said.
Praxair was not immediately available to say what the purchase price was for Henkel's interest or what the current revenues of the venture are.
